info.title: RunPass API — contrato inicial parcial
info.description: Review contract covering primary mobile and operational MVP journeys. Proposed routes/schemas, not deployed endpoints. x-required-role, x-required-permission, x-requires-mfa and x-requires-beta-admission document backend checks; they do not enforce security automatically. Cognito signup/login/token recovery are provider flows, not implemented by this API. Coverage is not proof of completeness. Contract coverage reviewed against PRD; official medal references and edition versions added. Structural validation is not functional/security certification. Share cards are generated locally in Flutter using authorized current data; no backend card-rendering endpoint is required by the approved MVP.

post.description: Conclui rascunho existente, exigindo oito notas e imagem validada; versão e estado da edição revalidados. Identidade vem do token. Não publica se a visibilidade escolhida for oculta.
Cria intenção autenticada de upload. URL temporária não dispensa validação posterior do arquivo.
Confirma transferência e inicia validação do objeto pertencente ao usuário. Meta 5 segundos pós-upload; pendente não significa sucesso. HEIC requer solução compatível ainda em revisão.

get.description: Owner can read a draft; other authenticated users see only an authorized completed projection. Recheck deletion, account status, blocking and result visibility at read time.

delete.description: Owner-only logical deletion with durable cleanup job. On acceptance, hide participation and post and block interactions; physical cleanup and RunScore are asynchronous. Preserve shared catalog images. Same idempotency key returns the original operation. Retention and lake deletion policy remain separate.

202.description: Hidden; cleanup accepted, not proof of erasure from backups

get.description: Current authorized review only. Owner may read correction status; public callers do not see invalidated or pending-review content. No lake history is returned.

post.description: Create an owned draft. Does not create a public post, a completed medal or a RunScore contribution. Server checks identity, source and uniqueness. Preserve data if the edition is unavailable for completion.

201.description: Draft created, or same result on replay

get.description: Owner-only list, including drafts when requested. Never serves another user private drafts.

200.description: Authorized page; cursor opaque and tied to filters

get.description: Owner-only status even when participation is no longer visible. Subject to account deletion access rules.

List approved catalog editions. namePrefix matches only the start of normalized title; city, date range and distance can combine. Stable pagination; dateFrom <= dateTo. No public pending requests. Normalization and filter index plan remain proposals.
Read an approved edition. Archived editions preserve history but prohibit new completion or transfer.

List currently valid public reviews for this edition, optionally filtered by distanceId. Filtering reviews does not create a separate distance RunScore. Recheck moderation, blocking and account visibility; never return lake versions.

Search runners by name or username. Match semantics and limits are still technical proposals; do not silently restrict product search to username-only. Exclude deleted/suspended accounts and apply blocks.
Authenticated public profile with current access rules. Never returns email, birth date or private drafts.
Owner profile only; account admission is a separate workflow.

patch.description: Owner changes profile fields, not age eligibility or operational roles. No birth date changes or role management through this route.

delete.description: Explicit confirmed owner request. Block API access and hide profile/content on acceptance, including requests using previously issued tokens; cleanup asynchronous. No deadline or retention exception invented. Receipt returned once before access is disabled; recovery/support mechanism is pending and must not reopen normal API access. No automatic refund of beta slot.

get.description: Completed authorized history only. No drafts. Hide time/pace/placement according to each participation and apply deletion, blocks and account state. Hidden feed post alone does not hide completed profile history.
Authorized medals associated with completed history; excludes removed participation and does not leak hidden results.

post.description: Owner submits required name/date/city/distance. Request stays private pending review, not an automatic public edition.

get.description: Owner list including review outcomes; no other users private requests.
Owner-only request and decision. Admin review is a separate privileged contract.

patch.description: Correct rejected request, preserving participation draft; no review decision or automatic resubmission. State and version revalidated.

post.description: Resubmit corrected rejected request for human review, preserving draft. Required fields must remain valid; transition rejected -> pending.

get.description: Followed authors first, other eligible public authors second; newest original publishedAt first within each group, stable tie-breaker. Cursor must preserve group/filter/user context. Recheck visibility, deletion, account status and bilateral blocks. Do not restrict all content to shared editions. No algorithmic ranking approved.
Return a currently authorized visible post. Hiding does not delete the underlying participation; no lake audit history returned.

patch.description: Owner sets visibility without deleting participation or changing original publication date. Only confirmed state changes emit effects; no duplicate notices on retries. This response may acknowledge hidden state even though public GET no longer returns the post.

put.description: Idempotent follow, at most one active relation per actor/target. Reject self-follow and any bilateral block; recheck concurrently with block commands. Confirmed block removes follow in both directions. Retry never recreates a blocked relation or duplicates notifications/counters; unblock requires explicit new follow.

delete.description: Idempotently remove the caller relation only. Never grant access to deleted, hidden or suspended content. Do not silently recreate follow or notifications.

put.description: Confirm caller block and remove follow relationships in BOTH directions. Prevent new follows, likes and comments while either-direction block is active. Preserve and hide previous likes/comments between involved users. Repeated requests must converge without duplicate side effects; handle concurrent follow/block consistently and update feed priority/counters. Unblocking never recreates removed follows.

delete.description: Remove caller block idempotently. Preserved prior interactions become eligible only if currently authorized: opposite block, deletion, hiding, suspension and moderation remain effective. Do not recreate either-direction follow relationships removed by blocking; each actor may explicitly follow again if allowed.

put.description: At most one active like per actor/post. Check post access and blocks; idempotent retry must not duplicate notice or counters. Self-interactions never count toward beta social metric.

delete.description: Idempotent removal of own like. Behavior when post becomes inaccessible must avoid leaking its existence; final error policy pending.

get.description: Only authorized visible comments and authors; apply moderation, deletion and bilateral blocks before returning.

post.description: Authenticated actor may comment only on accessible post. Durable create and idempotency prevent retry duplicates. No private messaging, replies or mentions introduced.

delete.description: Owner removes own comment; moderator removal uses privileged route elsewhere. Public visibility stops on confirmation. Cleanup asynchronous if required; no implicit authorization to erase other users comments.

patch.description: Author-only text edit with optimistic version and idempotency. Preserve createdAt and existing identity; set edited=true and editedAt on actual text change. Replay or unchanged text must not generate a new edit timestamp. Recheck post visibility, deletion, moderation, account state and bilateral blocks; an edit must not republish hidden content. No role or author changes accepted. Lake history approved for reviews is not automatically extended to social comments.

200.description: Updated owned comment, or same idempotent result

get.description: Owner can read saved editions regardless of public preference.
Default public but owner may hide; recheck current preference and blocks. Do not return an empty list to pretend an access denial is an actual empty wishlist. Exact denial status policy pending.

put.description: id is editionId. Idempotently save a future edition; revalidate catalog status and avoid duplicates. Behavior after event date passes needs final specification.

delete.description: id is editionId. Owner removes saved edition idempotently. Does not cancel any external registration.

put.description: Replace own wishlist visibility preference, public by default. Changes must affect public reads immediately after confirmation despite cached lists.

get.description: Owner-only in-app notices. No mobile push introduced. Retention and bundling policies pending.

put.description: Idempotently mark own notice as read; read-state is a technical proposal, not an additional notification channel.

get.description: Bootstrap route available to authenticated users before admission; no other participant details. Never equate Cognito signup with a consumed beta slot.

post.description: Verified authenticated eligible user enters if capacity exists. Transaction reserves unique admission and increments total exactly once, including concurrent 50th/1000th transitions. Same replay never consumes a second slot. If full or closed return 409 with a stable error code; do not silently enroll in waitlist. Identity may exist before admission but product access remains blocked.

Authenticated eligible user explicitly joins private waitlist after capacity is reached; no email link needed for installation. Does not consume admission or activation denominator. Deduplicate by identity. Reuse eligibility validation and avoid unnecessary duplicate birth-date storage.

get.description: Own waitlist only; waiting user need not be admitted.

delete.description: Remove own waitlist entry without changing lifetime admitted count. Any data-retention exception requires privacy policy.

post.description: Submit private report for human moderation. Does not remove content automatically and never returns reporter to public callers.
Voluntary beta feedback. Technical category survey supports approved in-app questionnaires, not a new compulsory step. Processing permission for waiting users must be reviewed.

get.description: Admin-only review queue, optionally filtered by status; index eventual but action revalidates current state.

post.description: Approve/link request to validated catalog edition or reject with reason; preserve associated draft and emit notice. Does not complete participation automatically.
Administrator creates catalog edition, not automatic organizer self-service.

patch.description: Administrator corrects catalog metadata with version check and audit. Distance changes preserve references. Replacing official medal image affects new bindings only; existing medals retain immutable bound version and user photos stay unchanged. Do not erase referenced objects or use generic PATCH to unarchive. Retroactive medal-image correction needs a separate explicit audited action, not specified here. Official image binding accepts only a validated administrative image reference for the same edition/distance and environment; reject pending/failed, foreign-target or runner-upload references. Preserve the previous binding on failure. Confirm explicitly after preview using expectedVersion and idempotency; audit actor, target and old/new references without signed URLs. The upload itself never publishes.

post.description: Archive blocks new participations, draft completion and inbound transfers. Existing history remains readable/editable/deletable. Concurrency rechecked in completion path.

get.description: Moderator-only queue; do not infer administrator inherits moderator permission. Assign both roles explicitly if required.

post.description: Moderator with MFA applies an audited action with reason. Rating invalidation preserves participation, medal and post; correction remains pending until approved. No permission management here.

put.description: Specifically privileged administrator manages an explicit operational role. Do not grant access to lake merely by administrator name. Revocations must affect API authorization, not only UI.

get.description: Explicitly authorized administrator with MFA and separate review-history:read grant only. Not accessible to ordinary admins by default, moderators or runners. Audit every query; filter expired/deleted records according to privacy policy. Asynchronous delivery may delay latest events. No arbitrary S3 object browsing or editable history.

post.description: Moderator with MFA resolves report with decision and reason. Revalidate version, ownership of operational scope and referenced action. Persist audit record. Idempotent retry returns same resolution; conflicting resolution yields 409. No automatic suspension/removal and no public internal rationale. Reopen policy not yet specified.

get.description: Administrator-only catalog reference management with MFA and audit. Reject blank names, preserve edition references, enforce version/idempotency on writes. No organizer login or private contacts introduced. Search matching and deduplication policy pending.

post.description: Administrator-only catalog reference management with MFA and audit. Reject blank names, preserve edition references, enforce version/idempotency on writes. No organizer login or private contacts introduced. Search matching and deduplication policy pending.

get.description: Administrator-only catalog reference management with MFA and audit. Reject blank names, preserve edition references, enforce version/idempotency on writes. No organizer login or private contacts introduced. Search matching and deduplication policy pending.

patch.description: Administrator-only catalog reference management with MFA and audit. Reject blank names, preserve edition references, enforce version/idempotency on writes. No organizer login or private contacts introduced. Search matching and deduplication policy pending.

post.description: Authorize a private temporary JPEG/PNG upload for an existing edition and optional distance. Check administrator permission and MFA at the API. Validate real format, size and decodability on the server after upload. User-owned upload references cannot be promoted through this flow. Does not change catalog or consume a runner beta slot.

Verify session target and uploaded object; start retry-safe validation. Reject expired or mismatched session with 409. Remove GPS, preserve orientation and optimize toward 1 MB. Repeated finalization must not duplicate processing effects. Pending or failed images cannot be linked; exceeding the five-second target does not imply success or invalidity. Catalog publication remains a separate version-checked PATCH.

get.description: Read an authorized administrative upload session and processing state. Authorize administrator/MFA and target access on every call; unguessable IDs are not authorization.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Escopo por ator e operação; corpo diferente com mesma chave gera conflito.

Error.description: Falha sem conclusão parcial; código HTTP distingue autenticação, acesso, conflito e validação

medalImageReference.description: Imagem do catálogo ou upload do usuário validado; formato de referência ainda em revisão.

Participation.description: Authorized projection. Optional and hidden results are omitted for other callers. Birth date and private draft data are never public.

bibNumber.description: Visibility not yet approved; do not include in public projections by default.

comment.description: Optional; omission in PUT removes previous current comment. Preserve before/after audit event in restricted lake, retained 60 days from original occurrence. Privacy erasure policy still requires specification.

PatchParticipation.description: Only supplied fields change; null clears optional results. Does not accept review ratings/comment: use PUT /review. expectedVersion and at least one field required. distanceKm applies only to a request draft. New field formats remain technical proposals.

showTime.description: False also hides pace in every authorized projection.

distanceKm.description: Only for a missing-edition request draft before it has a catalog distanceId. Final completion resolves a valid catalog distance.

ParticipationPatchFields.description: Somente campos enviados s?o alterados. Null limpa resultados opcionais. N?o aceita ratings/comment de avalia??o; usar PUT /review. Unidades e formato abaixo s?o propostas t?cnicas.

CreateParticipation.description: Creates a private draft, not a completed participation. Source must be exactly one approved edition or a request owned by the caller.

distanceKm.description: Used with owned editionRequestId until catalog distanceId exists.

medalImageReference.description: Current official image for new bindings in this distance; existing medals retain their bound version.

value.description: Null if no valid reviews. Display one decimal.

state.description: Brazilian state code, distinct from edition status.

status.description: Draft status vocabulary; date and archival state must remain distinguishable.

medalImageReference.description: Validated catalog medal image reference; optional when catalog image is unavailable. Never contains permanent S3 credentials.

organizerId.description: Optional catalog organizer reference; server validates existence. Not required for unknown historical organizer.

OwnProfile.description: Owner projection currently uses only public profile fields. Private account fields require a separate explicit schema; do not append email or birth date to this response.

PatchOwnProfile.description: Only sent fields change. Null clears optional fields. Username changes must reserve normalized name atomically. Lengths and rename policy require review.

imageSource.description: Distinguishes official catalog image from runner-owned photo; do not expose raw S3 object keys. Field added for contract review.

imageVersionReference.description: Immutable content/version reference bound at medal registration, not a raw S3 key. Existing official medals keep this version when catalog reference changes.

PublicMedal.description: Authorized medal projection. Hidden time omitted. Reference resolves to version bound at registration; catalog updates do not rewrite existing medal images. Own uploaded photos are separate. Any retroactive official-image correction requires explicit audited administration, not implicit GET behavior.

EditionRequest.description: Owner-only view, not a public catalog record. Reviewed request preserves associated draft until owner completes it.

PatchEditionRequest.description: Owner correction, no privileged review status fields. Proposed correction is allowed in rejected state; approved/linked requests point to the catalog rather than permit arbitrary edits.

Post.description: Publicly visible authorized projection only. Preserve original publishedAt on edits; omit hidden results, drafts, removed content and private account fields.

edited.description: True after a persisted text change. Display edited marker; createdAt is preserved.

editedAt.description: Most recent actual text change; absent before first edit.

CreateComment.description: Whitespace-only text rejected. Length and rate limits pending technical review; not unlimited in implementation.

Notice.description: Owner-only notice; no permanent access to referenced resource. Opening rechecks current access. Do not include old review text, hidden results or sensitive payload in a notice.

BetaAdmissionInput.description: Authenticated verified identity required. Server validates complete age >=18 at admission; birth date private. Future, impossible or underage dates rejected. Never trust an age computed only by client.

BetaAdmission.description: betaEndsAt only available after the 50th admission starts the 60-day window. Do not fabricate a date before that threshold.

WaitlistEntry.description: No automatic admission or promised queue position. Private entry for authenticated eligible identity.

AccountDeletionReceipt.description: Receipt is not proof that all physical copies/backups/lake records have been erased. Status retrieval after account access is blocked requires a separate approved support flow.

CreateReport.description: Report text and identity private; server validates target visibility and prevents arbitrary enumeration. Reason vocabulary and text limits pending.

FeedbackInput.description: Voluntary feedback; no hidden results or birth date automatically attached. Content requirements differ by survey and still need definition.

ReviewRequestDecision.description: Link/approve require existing editionId. Reject requires reason. Conditions enforced below and by server.

ModerationCommand.description: Allowed action/target combinations must be validated. Never interpret hide_comment as deleting ratings. Approval of correction requires all eight current ratings.

RoleChange.description: No self-escalation. Bootstrap first admin, last-admin safeguards and revocation timing still require review.

state.description: Brazilian state code, distinct from edition status.

status.description: Archiving existing edition uses dedicated command.

medalImageReference.description: Validated current official catalog image. Replacement applies to new medal bindings; existing medals retain their bound immutable image version. Never alter user photos or delete referenced versions. Retroactive correction requires explicit audited action; clearing catalog reference does not erase old medals.

organizerId.description: Optional catalog organizer reference; server validates existence. Not required for unknown historical organizer.

AdminEditionInput.description: Draft administrative catalog schema. Derived score/count cannot be set by client. Distances and medal images require validation. Status/archive edits through generic PATCH prohibited.

state.description: Brazilian state code, distinct from edition status.

medalImageReference.description: Validated current official catalog image. Replacement applies to new medal bindings; existing medals retain their bound immutable image version. Never alter user photos or delete referenced versions. Retroactive correction requires explicit audited action; clearing catalog reference does not erase old medals.

organizerId.description: Optional catalog organizer reference; server validates existence. Not required for unknown historical organizer.

AdminEditionPatch.description: Proposal: at least one editable field beyond expectedVersion; metadata only, archive through command.

ReviewAuditRecord.description: Restricted lake projection, never returned by public review APIs. Exclude expired records at query time; retention from original occurrence. Audit envelope in separate JSON Schema is authoritative pending consistency validation.

text.description: Whitespace-only text rejected by server; maximum length still pending.

reason.description: Internal rationale; reject whitespace-only text. Maximum length pending.

moderationActionId.description: Optional reference to an explicitly executed action, not an automatic enforcement request.

ReportResolution.description: Internal projection only; no addition to public report receipts or user notices by inference.

Organizer.description: Catalog reference only, not an application identity, operational role or portal account.

distanceId.description: Optional distance belonging to the target edition.

uploadMethod.description: HTTP method for the signed uploadUrl; send the file bytes with uploadHeaders.

AdminMedalImageUploadSession.description: Private temporary upload authorization; does not publish or bind the image. Required request headers, if any, are returned in uploadHeaders.

imageVersionReference.description: Immutable validated reference; returned only when valid. Must be bound explicitly to the same catalog target.

previewUrl.description: Temporary authorized URL of processed image only; returned only when valid.

AdminMedalImageUploadStatus.description: Pending is not success. Valid includes imageVersionReference; failed includes failureCode and failureMessage. No original unprocessed image is served. Five-second target after upload under normal conditions is subject to testing, not a hard timeout.
